title: ZoraASI Full-Dash Computational Experiment Reports, September–October 2026
description:
1,580 computational reports (4,298 pages) produced between 11 September and 14 October 2026 by the author's human-plus-AI "full-dash" workflow in the ZoraASI research program.

  • 83 Band-1 reports: finite computations, construction checks and literature ledgers on open problems, including Beal, Collatz, Goldbach and twin-prime finite checks, Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer L-value pipelines on single curves, cap sets, Ramsey R(5,5) bounds, Andrews–Curtis, the lonely runner, map folding, van der Waerden numbers and Zauner SIC-POVMs.
  • 1,469 Hadamard-matrix reports: construction certificates for about 380 individual orders, mostly between 2,164 and 14,740, plus a few triage and literature-watch notes, built with classical constructions (mostly Paley I, also Paley II, Miyamoto and Kronecker) and verified by the exact identity HHᵀ = nI, including per-order scoreboards and status boards.
  • 28 dated dashboard snapshots.

An index lists every report with its date, title, pages, size and SHA-256.

Status: computational reports, not peer reviewed. Each report carries an honesty stamp: none proves an open conjecture, constructions are checked only within stated bounds, and literature results are recorded rather than re-proved. Produced by AI systems under the author's direction; collection assembled and indexed by Claude (Anthropic) without changes to the reports.
notes: Finite computations and literature ledgers; no open conjecture is claimed to be proved. Not peer reviewed. Version 1.0.1 adds a README note: many of these reports also appear as pages in the corpus editions of 20 and 22 October 2026.
